user.title: Wellbeing Tracker
user.description: Adds a dashboard card, sensors for each person and medication, and actions to answer reminders and log doses. Everything comes from the Wellbeing Tracker app, which is already running.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the Wellbeing Tracker app. Check it's running, then try again.

abort.already_configured: Wellbeing Tracker is already set up.
abort.no_app: Install and start the Wellbeing Tracker app first. It sets this up for you.

answer_reminder.name: Answer a reminder
answer_reminder.description: Answers a Wellbeing reminder, the same as tapping its button on your phone.

reminder_id.name: Reminder
reminder_id.description: The reminder's number, from the Reminders waiting sensor.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: taken, snooze or skip. Mood and water buttons work too, for example MOOD_7 or WATER_1.

log_dose.name: Log a dose
log_dose.description: Logs a medication as taken now. It counts towards a reminder that's due and comes off the supply.

medication.name: Medication
medication.description: Its name, as in the Wellbeing app.

quantity.name: How many
quantity.description: Leave empty for the usual amount.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who took it. Leave empty for whoever runs the action.
